title: feat(claude-code): Replace OAuth with CLI subprocess integration
author: Drilmo

test_results.reason: All existing tests deleted (1,586 lines), no new tests added for CLI subprocess integration. Cannot test without implementation of test suite.

lessons.title: Subprocess security requires same rigor as network code
lessons.description: Spawning subprocesses introduces command injection, temp file handling, and resource management risks. Need input validation, cleanup handlers, and secure temp file handling.

lessons.title: Test deletion creates technical debt
lessons.description: Deleting 1,586 lines of tests without replacement leaves new implementation untested. Test coverage is non-negotiable for Tier 6 architectural changes.

lessons.title: CLI-first integration pattern
lessons.description: Delegating to official CLI (following Cline's proven approach) simplifies code by -3,144 lines but requires careful subprocess security and error handling.

lessons.title: Feature regression needs documentation
lessons.description: Simplification forced disabling of images, prompt cache, and native tools. Document why and provide roadmap for re-enabling.

lessons.title: Cross-platform edge cases need platform-specific tests
lessons.description: Windows has 8191 char CLI limit, Unix different. Platform-specific code needs tests on all platforms.

blocking_issues.description: Temp file race condition - predictable paths, no guaranteed cleanup, potential sensitive data leak
Subprocess input validation missing - allows command injection via claudeCodePath setting
